components.text: 1girl, red hair, black dress, sitting, indoors, night

components.name: Scene and interaction
components.text:
The woman is sitting beside a rain-streaked window. One hand rests on the worn wooden sill, and she looks toward the quiet street outside.

The window is on the left of the composition. The interior recedes into shadow behind her, leaving the brightest contrast around her face and hair.

children.name: Painterly rendering
children.text: Render the scene as a painterly anime illustration. Skin has soft, varied shading; the dark fabric has a subtle woven texture.

children.name: Moonlit interior
children.text: Warm interior light falls across her face, contrasting with the cool blue evening outside. Raindrops catch small highlights along the window.
